meta.title: Catch And Tame biomes data

sources.label: Roblox badges API - Catch And Tame discovery badges

meta.notes: The standalone Catch and Tame wiki lists 17 biomes with costs, animals, and route tips. Roblox badges cross-check eight discovered-area names, but several badge names use island wording that does not exactly match the standalone guide, so badge-only names are recorded as cross-check metadata instead of increasing the public count.

items.name: Starter Village / Farm
items.notableAnimals: Chicken, Butterfly, Dragonfly, Armadillo, Wormy, Cow, Goat, Pig, Sheep, Rabbit, Cat
items.progressionUse: First income route for filling early pens before buying paid areas.
items.imageStatus: text-only; no official badge or clean row-specific biome image found in inspected sources

items.name: Forest
items.notableAnimals: Fox, Deer, Boar, Wolf, Forest Wolf, Bear, Koala, Moon Cat, Moose
items.progressionUse: Early free area for stronger starter catches and night-only targets.
items.weatherOrSecretNote: Wolf uses Bone Bait; Forest Wolf and Moon Cat appear at night.
items.imageStatus: text-only; no official badge or clean row-specific biome image found in inspected sources

items.name: Jungle
items.progressionUse: Low-cost paid unlock that starts the Giraffe breeding route through Capybara.
items.weatherOrSecretNote: No weather-only note found in the biome guide.
items.imageStatus: text-only; no official badge or clean row-specific biome image found in inspected sources

items.name: Savanna
items.notableAnimals: Lion, Leopard, Zebra, Hippo, Kangaroo, Elephant
items.progressionUse: Second paid step with mounts and Elephant for the Toad breeding path.
